title: Mob Psycho 100 III
synopsis:
After foiling a world-threatening plot, Shigeo "Mob" Kageyama returns to tackle the more exhausting aspects of his mundane life—starting with filling out his school's nerve-racking career form. Meanwhile, he continues to assist his mentor Arataka Reigen and the office's new recruit, Katsuya Serizawa, in solving paranormal cases of their clients. While continuing his duties, Mob also works on gaining more independence in his esper and human lives, as well as trying to integrate better with the people around him.

However, new supernatural and ordinary challenges test Mob’s emotional stability and force him to confront the realities around him. As he strives to continue forward on the path to maturity, Mob must resolve his emotional crises and reassess the naivety he has held on for so long.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
synopsis_es:
Después de frustrar un complot que amenaza al mundo, Shigeo "Mob" Kageyama regresa para abordar los aspectos más agotadores de su vida mundana, comenzando por completar el angustioso formulario de carrera de su escuela. Mientras tanto, continúa ayudando a su mentor Arataka Reigen y al nuevo recluta de la oficina, Katsuya Serizawa, a resolver casos paranormales de sus clientes. Mientras continúa con sus deberes, Mob también trabaja para ganar más independencia en su vida humana y esper, además de tratar de integrarse mejor con las personas que lo rodean.

Sin embargo, nuevos desafíos sobrenaturales y ordinarios ponen a prueba la estabilidad emocional de Mob y lo obligan a enfrentar las realidades que lo rodean. Mientras se esfuerza por seguir adelante en el camino hacia la madurez, Mob debe resolver sus crisis emocionales y reevaluar la ingenuidad que ha mantenido durante tanto tiempo.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: Future: Career Paths
episodes_data.description: A giant broccoli known as the Divine Tree grows in the middle of the city and looks down upon Seasoning City. It`s time to fill out surveys about career paths at Salt Middle School and the students are filled with various feelings. While they all talk about their hopes and dreams, Mob can`t seem to think of anything himself.

episodes_data.title: Yokai Hunter Amakusa Haruaki Appears! The Threat of a Hundred Demons!!
episodes_data.title_es: ¡Aparece el cazador Yokai Amakusa Haruaki! ¡¡La amenaza de cien demonios!!
episodes_data.description: Mob is very busy preparing for the cultural fair that`s coming up in two weeks. Meanwhile, Serizawa is trying to start over, and is thinking about going to night school.

episodes_data.title: Getting Carried Away: 100%
episodes_data.description: Mob is in a great mood because he got to talk to Tsubomi for the first time in a while. As he`s walking through town, he feels the stares of other girls...

episodes_data.title: Divine Tree 1: The Founder Appears
episodes_data.description: After Psycho Helmet`s appearance, tree roots start emerging all around the city. Sensing danger, Mob goes with Reigen and Ritsu to destroy the Divine Tree, but eventually, they are overwhelmed by the members of the Psycho Helmet Religion.

episodes_data.title: Divine Tree 2: Peace
episodes_data.description: Mob heads into the Divine Tree, only to have to face off with Teru. Mob finds himself speechless, having to confront even Teru who has been completely brainwashed by Psycho Helmet.

episodes_data.title: Divine Tree 3: Dimple Is
episodes_data.description: Mob`s attitude seems to change once he hears what Dimple says. Mob ends up apologizing to Dimple because he had gotten carried away from the thought of being popular and didn`t hear what Dimple had to tell him before.

episodes_data.title: Transmission 1: Winter Break
episodes_data.description: Kurata Tome has always dreamed about communicating with the universe through telepathy, and now, her high school graduation was drawing nearer. When they are about to start winter break, she tells the Telepathy Club that she is going to disband them.

episodes_data.title: Transmission 2: Encountering the Unknown
episodes_data.description: The group somehow finally makes it to the summit of Mt. Mudboat. Takenaka had been up all night reading all the texts about UFOS and the Telepathy Club comes together to send a telepathic message into Space, but there is no UFO in sight.

episodes_data.title: Mob 1: Moving
episodes_data.description: After winter break is over, Mob is hit with shocking news. Tsubomi is actually going to transfer within the next month.

episodes_data.title: Mob 2: Rival
episodes_data.description: Mob tries to save a child that is about to be run over by a car and is run over himself. People start to gather but Mob stays silent.

episodes_data.title: Mob 3: Trauma
episodes_data.description: Mob continues to walk to the park where Tsubomi is waiting as he destroys everything around him, but the former upper echelon members from the Claw, Koyama, Sakuragi, and their boss, Suzuki stand in his way.

episodes_data.title: Confession: The Future
episodes_data.description: Mob continues down his path of destruction. Amongst all of the destruction and chaos, Reigen finally reaches Mob with the help of Serizawa, and he desperately tries to talk to him.
